description: Defines the internal immutable class DittoDuration for representing durations with positive amounts in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers package, including methods for creation from Duration objects and parsing from strings, along with associated utility functions and internal enum for time units.

classes.name: DittoDuration
classes.description: Immutable class representing a positive duration with methods for creation, parsing, and conversion to Java Duration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DittoDuration from a Java Duration, asserting that it is not null and not negative.

methods.name: parseDuration
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence into a DittoDuration, interpreting suffixes or defaulting to seconds.
